configurationType.description: Whether the application uses the default parallelism for the Kinesis Data Analytics service. Valid values: CUSTOM, DEFAULT. Set this attribute to CUSTOM in order for any specified auto_scaling_enabled, parallelism, or parallelism_per_kpu attribute values to be effective.

monitoringConfiguration.description: Configuration parameters for CloudWatch logging for an application. See monitoring_configuration Block below.

configurationType.description: Whether the application uses the default parallelism for the Kinesis Data Analytics service. Valid values: CUSTOM, DEFAULT. logLevel.description: Verbosity of the CloudWatch Logs for an application. Valid values: DEBUG, ERROR, INFO, WARN.

metricsLevel.description: Granularity of the CloudWatch Logs for an application. Valid values: APPLICATION, OPERATOR, PARALLELISM, TASK.

parallelismConfiguration.description: Parameters for how an application executes multiple tasks simultaneously. See parallelism_configuration Block below.

autoScalingEnabled.description: Whether the Kinesis Data Analytics service can increase the parallelism of the application in response to increased throughput.

configurationType.description: Whether the application uses the default parallelism for the Kinesis Data Analytics service. Valid values: CUSTOM, DEFAULT. Set this attribute to CUSTOM in order for any specified auto_scaling_enabled, parallelism, or parallelism_per_kpu attribute values to be effective.

parallelism.description: Initial number of parallel tasks that a Flink-based application can perform.

parallelismPerKpu.description: Number of parallel tasks that a Flink-based application can perform per Kinesis Processing Unit (KPU) used by the application.

runConfiguration.description: Starting properties for a Flink-based application. See run_configuration Block below.

applicationRestoreConfiguration.description: Restore behavior of a restarting application. See application_restore_configuration Block below.

applicationRestoreType.description: How the application should be restored. Valid values: RESTORE_FROM_CUSTOM_SNAPSHOT, RESTORE_FROM_LATEST_SNAPSHOT, SKIP_RESTORE_FROM_SNAPSHOT.

snapshotName.description: Identifier of an existing snapshot of application state to use to restart an application. The application uses this value if RESTORE_FROM_CUSTOM_SNAPSHOT is specified for application_restore_type.

flinkRunConfiguration.description: Starting parameters for a Flink-based application. See flink_run_configuration Block below.

allowNonRestoredState.description: Whether the runtime is allowed to skip a state that cannot be mapped to the new program when restoring from a snapshot. Default is false.

sqlApplicationConfiguration.description: Configuration of a SQL-based application. See sql_application_configuration Block below.

input.description: Input stream used by the application. See input Block below.

inputParallelism.description: Number of in-application streams to create. See input_parallelism Block below.

count.description: Number of in-application streams to create.

inputProcessingConfiguration.description: Input processing configuration for the input. An input processor transforms records as they are received from the stream, before the application's SQL code executes. See input_processing_configuration Block below.

inputLambdaProcessor.description: Lambda function used to preprocess the records in the stream before being processed by your application code. See input_lambda_processor Block below.

resourceArn.description: ARN of the destination Lambda function to write to.

inputSchema.description: Format of the data in the streaming source, and how each data element maps to corresponding columns in the in-application stream that is being created. See input_schema Block below.

recordColumn.description: Mapping of each data element in the streaming source to the corresponding column in the in-application stream. See record_column Block above.

mapping.description: Reference to the data element in the streaming input or the reference data source.

sqlType.description: Type of column created in the in-application input stream or reference table.

recordEncoding.description: Encoding of the records in the streaming source. For example, UTF-8.

recordFormat.description: Format of the records on the streaming source. See record_format Block above.

mappingParameters.description: Additional mapping information specific to the record format (such as JSON, CSV, or record fields delimited by some delimiter) on the streaming source. See mapping_parameters Block below.

csvMappingParameters.description: Additional mapping information when the record format uses delimiters (for example, CSV). See csv_mapping_parameters Block below.

recordColumnDelimiter.description: Column delimiter. For example, in a CSV format, a comma (,) is the typical column delimiter.

recordRowDelimiter.description: Row delimiter. For example, in a CSV format, \n is the typical row delimiter.

jsonMappingParameters.description: Additional mapping information when JSON is the record format on the streaming source. See json_mapping_parameters Block below.

recordRowPath.description: Path to the top-level parent that contains the records.

recordFormatType.description: Type of record format. Valid values: CSV, JSON.

initProvider.description:
THIS IS A BETA FIELD. It will be honored
unless the Management Policies feature flag is disabled.
InitProvider holds the same fields as ForProvider, with the exception
of Identifier and other resource reference fields. The fields that are
in InitProvider are merged into ForProvider when the resource is created.
The same fields are also added to the terraform ignore_changes hook, to
avoid updating them after creation. This is useful for fields that are
required on creation, but we do not desire to update them after creation,
for example because of an external controller is managing them, like an
autoscaler.

logStreamArn.description: ARN of the CloudWatch log stream to receive application messages.

createTimestamp.description: Current timestamp when the application was created.

forceStop.description: Whether to force stop an unresponsive Flink-based application.

lastUpdateTimestamp.description: Current timestamp when the application was last updated.

region.description:
Region where this resource will be managed. Defaults to the Region set in the provider configuration.
Region is the region you'd like your resource to be created in.

runtimeEnvironment.description: Runtime environment for the application. Valid values: SQL-1_0, FLINK-1_6, FLINK-1_8, FLINK-1_11, FLINK-1_13, FLINK-1_15, FLINK-1_18, FLINK-1_19, FLINK-1_20, FLINK-2_2, FLINK-2_3.

serviceExecutionRole.description: ARN of the IAM role used by the application to access Kinesis data streams, Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams, Amazon S3 objects, and other external resources.

startApplication.description: Whether to start or stop the application.

tagsAll.description: Map of tags assigned to the resource, including those inherited from the provider default_tags configuration block.

versionId.description: Current application version. Kinesis Data Analytics updates the version_id each time the application is updated.

items.description: A Condition that may apply to a resource.

lastTransitionTime.description:
LastTransitionTime is the last time this condition transitioned from one
status to another.

message.description:
A Message containing details about this condition's last transition from
one status to another, if any.

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration represents the .metadata.generation that the condition was set based upon.
For instance, if .metadata.generation is currently 12, but the .status.conditions[x].observedGeneration is 9, the condition is out of date
with respect to the current state of the instance.

reason.description: A Reason for this condition's last transition from one status to another.

status.description: Status of this condition; is it currently True, False, or Unknown?

type.description:
Type of this condition. At most one of each condition type may apply to
a resource at any point in time.

lastHandledReconcileAt.description:
LastHandledReconcileAt holds the value of the most recent
reconcile-requested-at annotation token that the controller has
processed. Users can compare this to the annotation to determine
whether a reconcile request has been handled.

observedGeneration.description:
ObservedGeneration is the latest metadata.generation
which resulted in either a ready state, or stalled due to error
it can not recover from without human intervention.
